article.title: Conditions of liability to pay advance tax.
article.content: Advance tax shall be payable by the assessee during a financial year, where the amount of such tax payable during that year, as computed under this Part, is Rs. 10000 or more.
article.html:
404Conditions of liability to pay advance tax.

Section 404 · Chapter XIX · C.—Advance payment of tax · page 486 of the Act

Advance tax shall be payable by the assessee during a financial year, where the amount of such tax payable during that year, as computed under this Part, is Rs. 10000 or more.
